review.notes: Full review of the 2.5-2.6 revision and the whole folder. All 15 seeded targets checked; 32 locators read against Chodosh (author page, 15 Sep 2025), White (arXiv 1308.3325v4) and CM4 (arXiv math/0210119v1), none wrong. CM (including the new [CM, 1.9] locators), ChoiSchoen, ChoiWang, Reilly, Frankel, WhiteReg and Bernstein were not readable. Adversarial table: 26 rows with computed values; the new 2.6 cocycle, injectivity, descent and scaling claims hold. Gate: the worker's run and this review's run pass; depcheck 244 roadmaps, 0 problems; nothing outside the folder changes. lake env lean: 5 sorry warnings only; #check of all 7 declarations matches; one-tactic probes close nothing. Four P3 findings: 2.6's helicoid pitch differs from parent R5a's by 2pi; 'concentric half-disk' is ambiguous; 2.2 has no locator for its estimate; the description omits the 2.5 locator change.
